tasks.title: Real disposable database replay and independent review
tasks.evidence: 2026-11-21: fresh PostgreSQL 16/Flyway V1-V30, packaged Spring jar and synthetic ADMIN. A four-product UTF-8 JSON dataset loaded through the real loopback API twice; both runs completed every loader stage and reported exactly four products with no pending order. Direct disposable-DB readback confirmed four expected SHOW-* variants, custom prices/stocks, one custom HERO section and one synthetic CUSTOMER. GPT-6.1 Sol medium code/product/SDD and security re-reviews both APPROVE after three P2 remediations; local suites remain 96/96 and 2/2. The operator loader has no browser surface; remote CI remains a PR gate, not evidence claimed here. Backend, container, temporary dataset and Docker Desktop were stopped/removed after evidence collection.
